topic: Sheet metal repair - patch repair, stop drilling of cracks.
syllabus_extract: Sheet metal repair - patch repair, stop drilling of cracks.
specific_objectives: 28.1.3.4 Trainee will be able to explain Sheet metal repair procedure.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of patch repair preparation and stop drilling technique; Safety precautions regarding PPE and tool handling; Instructor supervision of drill alignment and hole spacing.
intro_questions: What are the primary causes of sheet metal fatigue cracks?
List three safety precautions required before starting sheet metal repair.
Define the term 'stop drilling' in the context of crack repair.

topics: Assessment of crack extent and location
Preparation of surface for patch application
Selection of patch material and fasteners
Drilling of stop holes at crack tips
Application of patch and fastening sequence
development.content:
Assessment of crack extent and location
Preparation of surface for patch application
Selection of patch material and fasteners
Drilling of stop holes at crack tips
Application of patch and fastening sequence

topics: Placement and sizing of patch material
development.content:
Execution of stop drilling procedure
Placement and sizing of patch material
Fastening sequence and torque application
Inspection of repair integrity
Final surface finishing and sealing

Common defects in patch repairs
Troubleshooting fastener loosening issues
Documentation of repair records
Review of maintenance manual procedures
Safety review of repair zone

summary_questions: Explain the critical importance of stop drilling in preventing crack propagation.
Describe the correct sequence for applying a patch repair to ensure structural integrity.
Identify two potential failure modes if the patch is not fastened according to the specified torque.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report outlining the safety precautions and step-by-step procedure for composite repair as covered in the next lesson plan (LP 07), highlighting key differences from sheet metal repair.

pft_rows.syllabus: Composite repair - procedure and safety precautions while working of composites.
